Question: suppose we are in place were masajid is very far so how to offer tarabeeh? can i lead as imam by looking and recitting from quran? Answer ID: 16073 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1491/1496/M=1430) In this case, you can perform tarawih with some people at some proper place, but you will be deprived of the reward of performing the salah in mosque. (2) Reciting the Quran by seeing in the Quran will nullify salah though it is tarawih : وقرأتہ من المصحف أي ما فیہ قرآن مطلقاً لأنہ تعلم (الدر المختار ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
